# Dashboards 02: Coordinator home (Hospital)

Press “Take action” on a case: it leaves the queue, the saved message appears, the counters (tile, header button, side bar badge) go down and the activity gets a new entry. Filter the queue by required action, confirm an appointment's attendance, and switch to the mobile width to get the side bar as a drawer.

A complete standalone component built only from `@mod-internal/ui`, Angular and plain CSS with the library tokens. Copy it, rename the selector and class, replace the sample text and data with the project's own (and its translation mechanism), and keep the structure.

```ts

interface PendingCase {

  action: string;
  priority: 'Normal' | 'Urgent' | 'Emergency';

interface ActivityEntry {
  heading: string;
  body: string;
  actor: string;
  time: string;
  tone: 'default' | 'success' | 'error' | 'info';
  icon: string;
}

  ],
  template: `

      <span modAppShellTitle>Medical Referral and Patient Transfer Management System</span>
      <button modAppShellActions mod-button variant="subtle" size="medium" type="button" aria-label="Switch to Arabic">
        <mod-icon name="language-square" /> العربية
      </button>

          <mod-stat-card label="Running referrals" icon="hourglass" [value]="38" unit="referrals" />

        <div class="cols">
          <section class="panel" aria-labelledby="queue-title">
            <h2 id="queue-title">Pending actions</h2>

            @if (pending().length) {
              <ul class="queue" role="list">
                @for (item of pending(); track item.number) {
                  <li>
                    <div class="grow">
                      <p>
                        <strong>{{ item.number }}</strong>

                      <p class="meta">{{ item.detail }}</p>

                      <p class="meta"><mod-icon name="clock-01" /> Waiting since: {{ item.waiting }}</p>
                    </div>

  protected take(item: PendingCase): void {
```
